scraped.title: Education Reform Analysis
scraped.subtitle: Regional Sector – Specific Analysis in the Field of Education Reform and Labour Market
scraped.financing: Bundesministerium für wirtschaftliche Zusammenarbeit und Entwicklung (BMZ)
scraped.clientName: Deutsche Gesellschaft für Internationale Zusammenarbeit (GIZ) GmbH
scraped.description: The BMZ-financed project, implemented through the GTZ, aimed to develop a regional sector-specific study focusing on three key areas: accreditation of educational institutions and training curricula, certification of qualifying degrees, and labour market information for job…
body: The BMZ-financed project, implemented through the GTZ, aimed to develop a regional sector-specific study focusing on three key areas: accreditation of educational institutions and training curricula, certification of qualifying degrees, and labour market information for job seekers and labour demand. The project aimed to provide insights and strategies to improve these critical aspects of the education and employment sectors.
